title: Thread/get and Mailbox/query return null accountId
description: thread/get.rs handle_thread_get() returns "accountId": null. mailbox/query.rs handle_mailbox_query() returns "accountId": null. RFC 8620 §5.5 requires accountId to equal the authenticated account in all method responses. Compliant JMAP clients will reject these responses. Same structural defect as Email/query null accountId (filed separately).
